description: Group Passthrough with masks, on the stack of the group-masks golden: fields A at the root, above it a group at opacity 0.75 holding fields B (Multiply) under a uniform 0.2/0.9/0.5 fill (Screen, 0.5). s0-s3 the group in Passthrough, set per channel through Painter's UI (the documented BlendingMode.PassThrough does not exist at runtime): no mask, a mask on the group (grey A), on the Multiply child (grey B), on both; s4-s7 the same four with the group in Normal through the API. Channels RGB16, sRGB8 and RGB32F.
